title: Rules-to-Skills Map v1
description: The single declared map from a DADAIA.md law topic (a bold topic within a numbered section, or the section itself) to the skill(s) that operationalize it. Key = the bold topic of DADAIA.md (G9). One skill per topic by default; more than one only when the row carries a non-empty justification (FR7/A7.2). Every skill on disk must appear in exactly one row; not every topic has a skill (absent, never an empty row). This is the ONLY place a section-to-skill relation is declared (D4/A7.4) — no other file states one.

skill_md_line_ceiling.description: FR9/G12 — the declared line-count ceiling a SKILL.md's own content (not its disclosed sibling files) must stay within. Additive optional field (schema stays v1); the retired lint-skill-collisions.py-adjacent magic number now lives here as the one canonical declaration the FR9 enforcer test reads.

declared_overlaps.description: FR9/D4 — pre-cleared applyTo activation-glob overlap groups among non-universal skills, ported from the retired lint-skill-collisions.py's DECLARED_OVERLAPS. Any pairwise overlap among the members of the same group is intentional and never flagged; an overlap between two non-universal skills that share no group here is an FR9 defect.

topic.description: The law's bold topic name (e.g. 'Backlog', 'Task lifecycle'), or the section title itself when the section has no single unifying bold topic (e.g. 'Gitflow'). Titles/topics survive renumbering — never a bare section number alone.

section.description: The DADAIA.md section this topic lives in, title-anchored: '§N <Section Title>' using the CURRENT numbering (never a bare '§N').

skills.description: The skill(s) under dadaia_workspace/public/skills/<name>/SKILL.md that operationalize this topic.

justification.description: Required non-null (non-empty string) when skills has more than one entry (A7.2). Null when skills has exactly one entry.
